decision: archive duplicate header belonging to standalone SETCDS test program
checks: File matches the DOS 6.0 reference and the core inc/curdir.inc byte for byte.
The local copy is used by the standalone bios/setcds/setcds.asm program, which calls INT 21h 4C00h to terminate.
The selected core BIOS build searches bios/ and inc/, not bios/setcds/; core modules use inc/curdir.inc.
limitations: Archiving the duplicate does not alter the retained core header or establish target correctness of its consumers.
